title: One suite of T-495's claimable half: source-contract360-synthesis-context rewritten from a source-text scanner into a behavioural suite, and wired
scope: One suite, because T-495's acceptance is per suite. It is suite 4 of the 11 in the claimable half; 7 remain.
The gated half of T-495 -- the rows carrying textIsTheSubject -- is NOT touched here.

This record exists so the T-770 control resolves this path's classification from the LATEST record rather than from the T-492 draw, which is left as the historical draw it is. Measured: with the workflow step added and this record absent, t770-scanner-wiring-refusal fails and names this suite.
method: Re-verified on origin/main bb0f9ee16d by running the suite, not by reading it: 1 passed of 1. The case was GREEN, and green was never the criterion: it read ask/index.ts as text and compared the positions of two substrings.
The scanner case was DELETED rather than repaired. A tighter pattern would have been the same defect with a longer fuse.

Replacement cases drive the real askIntelligence with a Contract 360 surface context. Retrieval is mocked at the same module boundaries c412-ask-answer-mode-wiring.test.ts uses, and the audited Anthropic client is mocked, because both are I/O. The synthesizer, buildSourceContract360PromptBlock and the model-input cleaner run for real.

Expected text is produced by calling buildSourceContract360PromptBlock over the same surface context and passing each line through cleanIntelligenceModelInputText, so no literal in the suite can drift from the builder.

The first draft anchored its non-vacuity check on the contract id and failed: the model-input cleaner rewrites internal ids (CT-T495-0001 reaches the model as 'CT T495'). That is a separate control and not this suite's subject, so the anchor is the vendor name, which the cleaner leaves intact.
Five mutations against ask/index.ts, each verified by git diff --numstat to have changed the file before the suite ran, and each also run against the deleted scanner for comparison.

suites.rationale: The deleted case asserted that ask/index.ts contains buildSourceContract360PromptBlock and that, in a slice of its text, the token 'sourceContract360PromptBlock,' precedes 'opts.conversationContextBlock,'. Measured against three mutations that change what a model receives -- the injection made unconditional, the block built from null instead of the surface context, and the block filtered out of the join -- it stayed green on all three. Four behavioural cases replace it: the selected contract's block reaches the model's system input for both shapes readSelectedSourceContractContext accepts (the Contract 360 page and the Source workspace selection); it arrives ahead of the caller's conversation context; and with no contract selected no block is sent, which is the case that fails when the injection is made unconditional.

mutations.mutation: drop sourceContract360PromptBlock from the conversationContextBlock array

mutations.catches: the ordering ahead of caller context

mutations.mutation: buildSourceContract360PromptBlock(...) || <the block header>, making injection unconditional
buildSourceContract360PromptBlock(null, ...) instead of the surface context
mutations.catches: the block being built from the caller's surface context
the block surviving the join into the prompt

residualsNotClosedHere: The directory src/lib/intelligence/ask/__tests__ still cannot be wired whole: measured on this base, 1 failed suite of 24, ask-guardrails.test.ts, left red on purpose behind an owner decision (T-497's gated half). The suite is named individually for that reason.

The committed test-ci-coverage-census.json on the base was already one file behind the tree (testFiles 2538 against 2539 measured); --check reports counts drift and exits 0 because counts are a report and not a gate. Refreshing it here absorbs that unrelated +1 alongside this change's own movement, and it is named so the diff is not read as this suite alone.
